<p>The latest daily maximum temperature is ranked against 1991-2020 maximum temperatures from the same calendar date and two days on either side. High percentile ranks indicate unusually hot afternoons for this time of year, while low ranks indicate unusually cool afternoons.</p>

<p>The latest daily mean temperature is ranked against 1991-2020 daily means from the same calendar date and two days on either side. High percentile ranks indicate unusually warm conditions for this time of year, while low ranks indicate unusually cool conditions.</p>
<p><a href="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/tmean-percentile-rank-latest.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full-resolution PNG</a></p>

<p>The latest daily minimum temperature is ranked against 1991-2020 minimum temperatures from the same calendar date and two days on either side. High percentile ranks indicate unusually warm nights for this time of year, while low ranks indicate unusually cold nights.</p>
<p><a href="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/mint-percentile-rank-latest.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full-resolution PNG</a></p>
